content.title: Nokia posts profit beat as AI, cloud demand boost optical sales
content.summary: (Reuters) -Nokia reported third-quarter profit which was ahead of market expectations on Thursday, driven by strong optical and cloud demand, including AI-focused data centre sales following its Infinera acquisition.  Comparable operating profit in the quarter through September reached 435 million euros ($507 million).  U.S. tariffs, a market slowdown and a weaker dollar had weighed on Nokia's business this year, prompting it to issue a profit warning in July.
